title: Rounded 64
subtitle: A printed 64-key case in two shells on a base that lets light through
role: Design, drawings for making, and the build
summary: A white printed case for 64 keys, drawn in August and September 2021: two shells with rounded edges around a tilted switch plate, on a translucent base.

sections.heading: Two shells and a base
sections.body: The top shell carries the rounded edge and the bottom one closes the case. The plate is tilted inside them. At the front edge it sits between a shoulder of the top shell and a step in the base, with 0.7 mm above it and 2.8 mm below.

sections.heading: Light through the base
sections.body: The base is translucent, so light from the board shows under the case. The photograph is the build; the dark picture beside it is a render of the same thing.
